label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is a False Positive (FP) because the sink (HTML output) applies ESAPI.encodeForHTML() to the user-supplied fileName, effectively sanitizing the payload. Alert 2 (java/path-injection) is a True Positive (TP) because the variable fileName (constructed from user input 'bar') is used directly in FileOutputStream (L76) without sanitization, allowing path traversal attacks.

evidence.note: FileOutputStream sink uses unsanitized fileName (derived from user input), confirming Path Injection vulnerability.
XSS sink (println) wraps fileName with encodeForHTML(), mitigating the XSS risk.
